name: Kaju Gathiya nu Shaak

ingredients.name: plain Gujarati gathiya, broken into short pieces

steps: Toast cashews in a dry pan for 3 minutes until lightly golden; set aside. Break gathiya into short pieces but do not crush to powder.
Heat oil and crackle mustard and cumin. Add onion, garlic and green chili; sauté 5–6 minutes until the onion softens.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chili, jaggery and salt. Cook 8 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until the masala becomes pulpy and glossy.
Add water and simmer 5 minutes to make a thick, tangy Kathiyawadi gravy. Stir in toasted cashews.
Turn off heat. Fold in gathiya only just before serving so some pieces soften while others retain bite. Garnish with coriander and serve with rotla.
tips: Gathiya absorbs gravy fast; add it at the table rather than simmering it for a long time.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
